summary: The 8-K reports OptimizeRx Corp's entry into a new $35 million senior secured credit agreement with Fifth Third Bank, comprising a $10 million revolver and a $25 million term loan, used to refinance existing debt and for general corporate purposes. The filing is a routine debt refinancing with no change of control, merger, or special situation. Terms include quarterly amortization and a five-year maturity. No tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. This event-driven analysis finds no special situation; the filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement.
